note_excerpt: Herbo shouts out his gang, No Limit, by using Master P’s real name, Percy Miller, as a comparison to himself. Master P is the founder of No Limit records, however, there is no association between G Herbo and the label. He’s used lines related to Master P before like on his 2015 track, “No Limit”: …l

Icewear Vezzo Is Referencing Los Angeles’ Stinc Team member, ‘Kellz’ who kept it 100 in the street and got it bacc in blood with Slim 400. Stinc Team’s famous Gang n em phrase relates to their team of winners and their past achievements in the street, or ‘hood trophies’.
